label: Coinitial Grim Reaper pieces give spaced Grim Reaper pieces
meaning: Strength order (linear time, any real clock): the local-pieces premise over coinitial populated descents gives it over spaced populated descents, because a descent whose slots last at least delta runs below every earlier moment. The converse fails: in the positive reals spaced local pieces hold for every register frame, while with silent registers coinitial local pieces fail (MetricGrimReaper control 2). No premise is established.
